summary: Blocking: .github/workflows/evals-model.yml adds the monthly schedule cron "17 3 1-7 * 1". In POSIX/GitHub Actions cron, when both day-of-month and day-of-week are restricted the schedule fires when either matches, so this runs at 03:17 UTC on every day 1-7 of each month AND every Monday, not only the first Monday. The workflow's FOREST_EVAL_TIER expression maps that exact cron string to the 'monthly' full pass^3 tier, so the expensive monthly tier would dispatch up to roughly 11 times per month instead of once, and repeated identical experiments would then fail duplicate-fingerprint rejection. Required state: the monthly tier must run only on the first Monday of the month (for example, a day-of-week cron plus an explicit day-of-month guard step, or another single-fire schedule). Evidence: evals-model.yml schedule block and tier expression; GitHub Actions POSIX cron OR semantics for restricted day-of-month and day-of-week. All configured checks (build, vet, test) pass, but the diff is not merge-ready. Non-blocking: evals/scripts/affected_role.py is currently not wired into the pipeline.
